full_details: In the morning at the Cross Keys you went through the comedy again. Garnish read no total. Kemp was told that Thursday may add and Wednesday may not. The pause stayed. Sincler kept the half-line small. At two the company played The Shrew. You were at the lodging, and you were not in it. After four you had the oath on the roll. At half past eight Alse stood in the door with the washing. You gave her three years' study, one meal a day, and no woman within a mile of the court. She asked who is to cook. Mistress Ansell called up that she was not to be encouraged after eight. You laughed with your shoulders. The memo after was short. The girl has never seen a play, and in the first minute she asked who is to cook.
one_sentence: You rehearsed once more, stayed home from the afternoon Shrew, and at night Alse heard the oath and asked who cooks.
title: Rehearsed again, and Alse asked who cooks
